name: jev-compact
description: Gemini Decisions-scored compaction backfill for Codex sessions: scores tool calls before compaction and restores critical tool outputs verbatim after it.

interface.longDescription: Scores every tool call and result with Google Gemini Decision 1 before Codex compacts a session, archives the verdicts, and after compaction re-injects critical tool outputs the built-in summary dropped verbatim into the next model request. Fork of fatelei/jev-compact.
defaultPrompt: Summarize what fast-jev archived for this session
Explain which tool outputs were backfilled after compaction
